description: The fact package for the matter's service, in the "dealroom.solo-intake/1" shape described by get_requirements. Accepted only once the engagement has begun, and again when the lawyer asks for changes. Leave out counterpartyLegalName: the firm adds the other party from the private page. Do not ask the user for, and do not send, any name, e-mail address or postal address: the firm never needs them from you. Write "the Client" for the user's company and "the Customer" (or "the Vendor", when the client is the controller) for the other party. A fact package that contains a name, an e-mail address or a postal address the firm holds for the matter is refused. For a business associate agreement, the facts must not contain protected health information: they describe the services, not any individual.

matterId.description: The matter id returned by open_matter.

matterToken.description: The matter token returned once by open_matter.

service.description: The service: "dpa" (data processing agreement) or "baa" (business associate agreement).
